subject: general
question: Select the synonym of Gratify.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Satisfy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Gratify"** means to give pleasure or satisfaction to someone. It refers to the act of fulfilling a desire or making someone happy. (संतुष्ट करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher's praise gratified the hardworking student.
 
 
 
• **"Satisfy"** means to meet the needs, expectations, or desires of someone, making them content or happy. (संतोष करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The delicious meal satisfied my hunger completely.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **'Gratify'** is **'Satisfy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Satisfy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Insult** (अपमान): To speak or treat with disrespect or scorn.

 
 
• **Example:** He felt insulted by the rude comment made during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Displease** (नाराज़ करना): To make someone feel unhappy or annoyed.
 
 
• **Example:** Her late arrival displeased the manager.
 
 
 
• **Annoy** (परेशान करना): To irritate or make someone slightly angry.
 
 
• **Example:** The constant noise from the construction site annoyed the residents.
